Nobody was paged, so the cost to responders is worth stating, but I won't put a number on the figures. The affected group is shoppers who bought before but not this month. input.overview: For {duration}, some shoppers on io-shop could not load their account pages. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests were failing. Someone had switched on a setting that sent account pages through new monthly-spending code. That code likely breaks for shoppers who have bought before but not this month, so their account pages failed. Argus estimates the shop lost {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody was paged, so no on-call responders were called out. To end the incident, Argus turned the setting back off by reverting the feature flag monthly-spend-feature. That change is confirmed and still in place. Argus has also proposed a fix to the code as PR #581, but it is still a draft and has not been applied.
